sections.kicker: Prepared for Blanx Apparel by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Blanx sells judgment from twenty years in apparel, and the bio says blanks.
sections.keep: The founder photographed inside the factory. It is the most believable image on the grid.

sections.label: Front door

meet first.

pins.what: The bio speaks to every brand, while your best caption speaks to studio owners.
pins.why: Studios that want merch recognise themselves in the caption, not in this line.
pins.how: Name the studio owner in the first line of the bio.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The niche you can win reads as a general apparel shop.

pins.what: The tagline sells the blank, the commodity.
pins.why: Your offer is design and production judgment. A blank is what every supplier offers.
pins.how: Put the judgment, not the garment, in the tagline.
pins.label: Your tagline
pins.cost: Studios compare you with any blanks supplier on price.

pins.quote: With nearly 20 years in fashion and hands-on experience in design and production
pins.what: The founder in the factory is your strongest proof.
pins.why: Twenty years of production experience is why Blanx and not the supplier next door.
pins.how: Make the founder and the factory floor the face of the brand.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The one asset a new competitor cannot buy stays in a single post.
